reviews.title: Absolute joke of a company – avoid wasting your time!
reviews.body:
Lebara is easily the most ridiculous company I have ever had to deal with. I ordered multiple Pay As You Go (PAYG) SIM cards, and none of them ever arrived.
When I contacted their online chat to find out what happened, the experience went from bad to worse. Even though I was completely logged into my account, they forced me to manually verify every single order. They dragged out the process by demanding my bank details, email addresses, order dates, and other personal information for each individual SIM.
What should have been a quick, simple status check turned into an absolute nightmare that wasted a massive amount of my time. What is the point of having a secure customer login if your support team makes you jump through endless, repetitive security hoops anyway?
Terrible shipping, useless customer service, and zero respect for their customers' time. Look elsewhere for a provider.

reviews.title: Excellent Support from Shoaib Khan — My SMS Issue Was Finally Resolved!
reviews.body:
**Outstanding Customer Support from Shoaib Khan! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**

I had been struggling with an issue with my Lebara UK eSIM for quite some time. I could receive SMS messages while roaming in China, but I was unable to send any.

After previous attempts to resolve the issue were unsuccessful, I was fortunate enough to be connected with Shoaib Khan.

Unlike my previous experience, Shoaib took the time to investigate my account carefully. He quickly identified an active roaming block, removed it, and within just a few minutes, my SMS service was finally working perfectly!

I genuinely appreciate his patience, professionalism, kindness, and willingness to actually solve the problem rather than simply giving me a standard response.

Shoaib Khan is an exceptional customer support representative and a real asset to Lebara. I sincerely hope his hard work and dedication are recognized by the company.

Thank you so much, Shoaib! You truly made my day! ❤️

reviews.title: I want to use a second phone as a…
reviews.body: I want to use a second phone as a backup so I bought & £5 Lebara Mobile SIM in a shop. It said 5GB data, 1000 mins & 100 texts. I put the SIM in the phone, typed in the voucher code etc. Tried to make a call, it said I had no credit. I never managed to make a call or text anyone. I could call their customer services who were very polite but completely useless. They said perhaps the data was being used by background processes, however, the phone hasn't left the house & is set to prioritise WiFi. I explained this & that I believe the data usage was erroneous.  I also explained that I was prepared to write off the data, but, if I couldn't use the minutes/texts I bought I would destroy the SIM, write this review & never use their services again. As they insisted there's  nothing they could do, the SIM is now in two pieces in the bin & review has been written.
